prompt: Review an unseen distributed business workflow packet. Choose the smallest valid transaction and coordination boundaries; design durable state, identities, compensation, outbox/effects, versioning and operations; recover one injected partial-failure incident; and revise the design after the reviewer changes one major correctness, scale, geography, privacy, provider or cost constraint.
deliverables: Business invariant, authority, local transaction and independent-effect map.
Local ACID, 2PC and saga comparison with chosen/rejected alternatives.
Choreography or orchestration ADR with durable state owner and failure model.
Versioned state machine with compensable, pivot, retryable and manual terminal states.
Operation, workflow, run, step, event, effect and compensation identity contracts.
Local outbox/inbox, relay fencing, schema evolution and retention design.
External effect/checkpoint crash-window, idempotency, result and reconciliation design.
Concurrent workflow controls, retry/deadline budget and compensation failure path.
Reliability SLI, security/authorization timing, observability, capacity, recovery and cost model.
Incident timeline, containment, repair, user validation, rollout/rollback, changed-constraint defense and cleanup proof.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized services, invariants, schemas, metrics, histories, provider behavior and one changed constraint.
No production/shared service, real credential, customer data, host network/clock mutation, unbounded retry or unknown cleanup.
Every state and durable fact has one authority, stable identity, legal transitions and retention owner.
Local atomicity is retained where one authority can enforce the invariant; distributed coordination is justified rather than assumed.
Every external and compensating effect is idempotent, atomic or explicitly ambiguous and reconcilable.
Faults cover state/outbox, relay publish, effect/checkpoint, stale owner, compensation and replay-version boundaries.
Concurrent workflows are controlled at the participant invariant using observed version/lock/commutative evidence.
Recovery calculations use continuing demand, sustainable bottleneck service, retry/compensation traffic and evidence horizon.
Authorization timing, least privilege, sensitive-history handling and manual audit are explicit.
Reviewer observes reconciliation, changed-constraint revision, delayed explanation, rollback safety and exact cleanup.
